name: historical-etf-overlap-2026-10-20
purpose: A fixed seam-spanning download overlaps both earlier and recent immutable histories; include December and March distribution periods without choosing dates from trading outcomes.
acquisition: Existing immutable full-range symbol chunks; bounded transient retries; no correction, fallback, rescaling or synthetic bar.

checks.calendar: Every XNYS session for all four symbols; no extra rows
checks.raw_source: Run the existing source/action audit before comparison
checks.split: Exact normalized factor equality; raw action consistency checked
checks.fail_policy: Any mismatch fails. Preserve all snapshots; no automatic harmonization or merge.

interpretation: Overlap consistency supports shared reported units locally at the seam; it cannot prove full-history vendor accuracy, historical vintages, or profitable policies. Mismatches require a separate explicit harmonization or reacquisition protocol, never widening this tolerance after observation.
